title: HEART Score: Clinical Chest Pain Risk Assessment
subject: Clinical Scoring Systems
preview: The HEART score combines History, ECG, Age, Risk factors and Troponin in evaluating selected chest pain presentations.
quickRevision: The HEART score combines History, ECG, Age, Risk factors and Troponin in evaluating selected chest pain presentations.
Troponin timing, ECG evolution and local chest-pain pathways still matter.
The score is not intended to dismiss unstable patients or obvious ongoing ischemia.

sections.title: Essential distinctions
points: The HEART score combines History, ECG, Age, Risk factors and Troponin in evaluating selected chest pain presentations.
It supports structured risk assessment but does not replace clinical judgment or assessment for non-ACS emergencies.

points: A low score is not a license to ignore red flags for aortic dissection or pulmonary embolism.
